Image Description: The image shows a plate of food arranged on a white ceramic dish with an orange and blue geometric pattern along the rim. The plate is placed on a wooden surface, likely a table. The meal consists of several distinct components:

- In the upper left portion of the plate are golden-brown roasted potato wedges, slightly crispy in appearance.
- To the right of the potatoes are slices of green pickled cucumber, garnished with yellow corn kernels, possibly indicating a relish or side
